ref.title: Referrals
ref.sub: A customer shares his invite code; a friend gets your code offer on his first order, and the customer may get a wallet reward once that order is delivered.
ref.note: Off as it ships. The friend's amount is the Smart Rule you pick (an offer that asks for a code); the reward is the amount you set below. Nothing is paid until a person with the wallet permission gives it after a confirm.
ref.rulesLink: Make or change the friend offer in Smart Rules
ref.live: Signed-in customers see their invite code under My account › For you.
ref.notLive: No invite card is shown and invite codes are not taken. Switch it on, pick the friend offer (a live rule) and check the days.

list.empty: No order has used an invite code yet.

block.CAP: This customer has had the most rewards

ref.confirm: Put {amount} into {name}'s wallet for order #{number}? This cannot be taken back here (a correction is a new wallet entry).

err.STALE: Someone changed this a moment ago. The card shows the latest; try again.
err.NOT_FOUND: This order is not in the list any more.
err.NOT_DELIVERED: The friend's order is not delivered yet.
err.CAP: This customer has had the most rewards.
err.forbidden: You do not have permission for this.

card.d: Changing these changes what customers pay: only the owner (Approve rules) can save.
card.readOnly: Only the owner can change these.
card.onHelp: Signed-in customers see their invite code and friends' codes are taken on a first order.
card.friendRuleKeyHelp: A rule whose offer asks for a code. Its amount is what the friend gets. None = codes are not taken.
card.rewardMinorHelp: Put into his wallet once the friend's order is delivered, by a person after a confirm. Empty = no reward.
card.codeLengthHelp: Letters and digits that cannot be misread.
